long_biography.plain_text:
Rennes entered senior care after earlier work in healthcare and familiarity with the field through his mother, a nurse. In 1973, he and Debbie opened a care facility in Peshtigo, then added a De Pere center in 1984 and further Wisconsin locations in the 1990s. Their organization later developed the state's first Residential Care Apartment Complex, extending its model beyond skilled nursing.

The enterprise now spans rehabilitation, independent and assisted living, memory care and nursing services. Management has passed to the next family generation, while Rennes retains substantial direct interests in six skilled-nursing facilities. His career reflects a long progression from hands-on local development to family stewardship of a regional care network.
